description: How Jest's testMatch globs combine in --listTests (U2): they match the absolute path, in order, and a later glob can undo an earlier one: a negated glob drops the paths it matches, and a positive glob after it brings some back. A relative glob (src/**) matches no absolute path. The list is recorded sorted. Jest only.

jest.src/keep/three.slow.test.ts: // brought back by the glob after the negation
jest.lib/six.test.ts: // a relative glob matches no absolute path
